status: PARTIAL -- sheet 1 complete; sheet 2 tiles 1-15 answered; he then slipped back to sheet 1 and said so

sheet1_litolff_beams_undecided_still_unw.11: a quarter note rest (not a note)
sheet1_litolff_beams_undecided_still_unw.12: half of a quarter note rest (not a note)
sheet1_litolff_beams_undecided_still_unw.13: a quarter note rest (not a note)

ours: Sheet 1: 17 of 24 are notes (16 eighths incl. one unison pair, 1 quarter); 7 are not notes (an sf, three sharps, three quarter-rest boxes) -- the trace agent's look had called all 24 real black beamed notes. Sheet 2 tiles 1-15: 14 notes (7 dotted quarters, 1 dotted eighth, 3 eighths, 3 sixteenths) and 1 box on a beam. Where the slip began is OUR inference from the repeated pattern (18 unison, 22 quarter); 16-24 of sheet 2 to be redone.
